2. "Tools" Companies Must Become "Agent" Companies

If your startup builds software, design tools, or simulation platforms (CAD, bio-sims, dev environments), your product strategy needs to shift. Rather than selling interactive UIs for humans, package your software into accelerated tools that autonomous AI agents can call directly to execute end-to-end workflows.

"Hope is not security." As autonomous agents gain system-level privileges to access databases, execute code, and trigger real-world actions, sandbox governance is non-negotiable.
